description: Pin this compiler into the PE Intermediate CA classifier group, which sets ica_enabled on profile::compiler_ica_ca so that its next Puppet run writes the ca.conf settings the ICA provisioning subcommand reads. The compiler stays a CA proxy: nothing here binds IntermediateCAService. Run before submit_ica_csr, followed by a Puppet run on the compiler. Called as part of promoting a proxy compiler to an intermediate CA; not meant to be run directly.

primary_host.description: Certname/FQDN of the PE primary hosting the classifier this task pins the compiler into.
